stages.name: policy_first_chat_engine
checks: Hypothesis: a zero-cost local API can apply scope, locale, Taiwan-name and medical-advice gates before any generation.

Proof: ten deterministic cases cover zh-TW, English, zh-Hans normalization, two non-Köhler drug refusals, medical-advice refusal, unknown approved-record fact, unprocessed taxon, Taiwan name metadata and image-capability disclosure.
A false-positive bug caused by the 毛 character inside 金狗毛蕨 was detected and fixed before promotion.

stages.name: live_http_contract
checks: POST /v1/chat returned a zh-TW answer with one approved page citation.
POST /v1/retrieve returned English evidence without answer generation.

stages.name: independent_evidence_validation
stages.tool: validate-chat-api.py plus existing policy, record, grounding, embedding and fulltext validators
checks: 10/10 API cases passed with zero external model calls.
Cibotium record retained approved evidence pages 30, 31, 32 and 79.
The 1,774-page FTS corpus and bounded Podophyllum bilingual embedding remained valid.
Tracked lab and n8n example files contained no Gemini key.

stages.name: n8n_and_google_portability
stages.tool: n8n 2.12.3 workflow import, SQLite inspection and OpenAPI 3.1 contract
checks: PEChatApi001 canonical nodes and connections matched the imported database record.
The workflow remained inactive and n8n remained stopped.
PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_CHAT_API_URL avoids embedding a secret or fixed executable path in the workflow.
Opal external HTTPS reachability remains explicitly unverified; localhost is not exposed publicly.

stages.name: image_reasoning
stages.tool: not enabled in this text-only bounded batch
checks: The API declares image_reasoning false and returns not_available_in_text_only_mvp when images are requested.
stages.retry_target: Add a separately reviewed plate retrieval and Gemini page-image checker batch.

warnings: The API currently exposes facts from one approved plant record plus one Taiwan name-metadata fixture; it is not a full-book chatbot.
Image reasoning is intentionally unavailable in this text-only MVP.
Opal cannot be assumed to reach a localhost endpoint without a separately approved authenticated HTTPS gateway.
